module_summary: Wishbone DDR3 SDRAM controller wrapper: a Wishbone-to-AXI bridge feeds a Xilinx MIG AXI memory controller driving DDR3 pins, and system reset is held until calibration and MMCM lock.

anchors.name: i_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone request strobe into the WB-to-AXI bridge.

anchors.name: o_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone acknowledge returned by the bridge per completed access.

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone write data converted to AXI write beats.

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data word-selected from AXI read data.

anchors.name: i_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address mapped to SDRAM AXI address.

anchors.name: i_wb_we
anchors.why: Selects AXI write versus read transaction.

anchors.name: o_wb_stall
anchors.why: Bridge backpressure to Wishbone master.

anchors.name: io_ddr_data
anchors.why: Bidirectional DDR3 DQ bus driven by MIG controller.

anchors.name: o_sys_reset
anchors.why: System reset held until MIG reset release, calibration and MMCM lock.

anchors.name: init_calib_complete
anchors.why: MIG calibration done; gates release of o_sys_reset.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: 128-bit AXI write data from bridge to MIG.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: 128-bit AXI read data from MIG to bridge.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from bridge to MIG.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid from bridge to MIG.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid from MIG to bridge.

anchors.name: mmcm_locked
anchors.why: MIG clock lock gating system reset release.

anchors.name: w_sys_reset
anchors.why: MIG UI-clock synchronous reset feeding o_sys_reset.

anchors.name: o_ddr_addr
anchors.why: DDR3 row/column address pins from MIG.

anchors.name: o_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone bus error from AXI error responses.

anchors.name: i_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone bus cycle framing.

groups.name: Wishbone-to-AXI bridge
groups.description: Converts pipelined Wishbone requests into single-beat AXI4 reads and writes.

groups.name: MIG DDR3 controller
groups.description: Black-box MIG AXI slave driving the DDR3 pins and calibration.

groups.name: Reset sequencing
groups.description: Holds system reset until MIG reset release, calibration and lock.
